record.name: HotPlot AI: Short Drama Maker
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
HotPlot AI is a planning workspace for creators who make short dramas and vertical series.

PLAN THE STORY
• Create a drama with genre, theme, audience, episode count and running time
• Build a cast with goals, secrets and relationships
• Outline every episode: opening hook, main scene, conflict, twist and ending hook
• Write scenes with location, action, dialogue and voice-over

STORYBOARD AND SHOOT
• Turn scenes into storyboard shots with shot size, angle, movement and duration
• Attach reference photos from your library or camera
• Keep a shooting checklist for cast, locations, wardrobe, props and equipment
• Read lines on set with a built-in teleprompter: speed, type size, mirroring and countdown

DESIGN AND EXPORT
• Design a cover poster in 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1 and export PNG or JPEG
• Export scripts as TXT, storyboards and checklists as PDF, and full projects as JSON

OPTIONAL AI DRAFTING
• Ask for a drama concept, story outline, characters, episode outline, script, ending hooks, tighter dialogue or a pace review
• Nothing is sent until you confirm. Drafts are written by OpenAI and clearly marked as AI-generated
• Every AI result is a starting point for you to review and rewrite

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account needed
• Projects are stored on your device. Only a brief you confirm is sent for AI drafting
• No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases

HotPlot AI is a tool for writing and planning. It does not stream or play short dramas.

Write For Me is the fastest way to draft, rewrite, and polish anything you type — powered entirely by Apple Intelligence on your device. No sign-ups. No subscriptions. No data ever leaves your iPhone or iPad.

Whether you're firing off a quick reply, crafting a professional email, or shaping an essay, Write For Me gives you a thoughtful first draft in seconds and lets you refine it with a tap.

— WHAT YOU CAN DO —

• Draft emails, essays, tweets, replies, and messages from a single prompt • Rewrite, shorten, expand, summarize, or improve any text instantly • Choose from 8 writing tones: Professional, Friendly, Funny, Formal, Persuasive, Casual, Empathetic, and Confident • Dictate your prompt with on-device speech recognition • Listen to results read aloud with natural text-to-speech • Save every generation to your private history • Star your favorites for quick access • Edit results inline and regenerate with a tap • Copy or share output anywhere

— WHY WRITE FOR ME —

100% PRIVATE Every prompt and every response stays on your device. There are no servers, no analytics, no tracking. Your words are yours alone.

NO SUBSCRIPTIONS Pay nothing. Ever. No paywalls, no token limits, no monthly fees. Apple Intelligence runs locally, so there's nothing to charge for.

WORKS OFFLINE Airplane mode, subway, remote cabin — Write For Me keeps working because it doesn't need the internet.

DESIGNED FOR APPLE Built natively in SwiftUI with Liquid Glass design, Dynamic Type, full Dark Mode, haptic feedback, and adaptive layouts for iPhone and iPad. Split-view multitasking is fully supported on iPad.

FAST AND FOCUSED Streaming output appears as it's generated. Suggested task chips and one-tap tone presets get you from blank page to polished draft without friction.

— HOW IT WORKS —

Type or dictate what you want to write
Pick a task (Email, Essay, Tweet, Reply, Message, or Freeform)
Choose a tone
Tap Generate — your draft streams in instantly
Refine with Rewrite, Shorten, Expand, or Improve
Copy, share, or save to favorites

Write For Me uses Apple Intelligence and requires a compatible device: • iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, or any iPhone 16 model • iPad with M1 chip or later • iOS 26.2 or iPadOS 26.2 (or later) • Apple Intelligence enabled in Settings

— PRIVACY PROMISE —

We don't collect your data because we don't have servers. There are no accounts to create, no logins, no cloud syncing. Your writing history lives only in the app, on your device, and you can delete any entry at any time.

Stop pasting your private thoughts into a chatbot. Start writing with an assistant that respects your privacy by design.

Download Write For Me and rediscover the joy of writing with a little help — privately.

ReWriteMe is a focused AI writing assistant for turning rough drafts into clear messages, emails, notes, captions, and replies.

Type, paste, or dictate a draft, then choose the tone that fits: friendly, professional, concise, formal, casual, or supportive. ReWriteMe rewrites your text in the original language, the system language, or another supported language, so you can polish and translate in one flow.

Use ReWriteMe to:
- Rewrite emails and messages before sending
- Fix grammar and make wording clearer
- Make replies warmer, shorter, or more professional
- Dictate an idea and clean it up
- Polish captions, notes, and everyday text
- Regenerate, copy, or replace the result quickly

ReWriteMe uses on-device writing models when available, including Apple Intelligence and a local MLX fallback on supported devices. It is built for quick edits, not long documents: open the composer, paste the draft, pick a tone, and send a cleaner version.

Students, teachers, writers, doctors, journalists, scholars and business professionals use Nautilus every day for class notes, meeting notes, marked-up PDFs, signed documents, papers and lectures.

Notes Writer Pro is now Nautilus, built on the all-new Notes Writer app. It carries forward familiar writing and PDF tools, then adds a smart web browser, AI help for reading and research, and Magic Lasso. Math Notebooks help you work through calculations and create charts, all in one place on iPad and iPhone.

Write and make it yours
Create notes, papers and books with headings, lists, colors and highlights. Add images or handwritten notes with Apple Pencil. Use dictation, listen back to your writing, check word counts, and keep documents open in tabs. Work with MS Word, RTF, Markdown and plain text files.

Read and mark up PDFs
Read ebooks, articles and class materials, then write in the margins, highlight, draw, and add notes, recordings or signatures. Fill and sign forms, reorder pages, and scan paper documents into PDFs. Compare two documents side by side. Measure drawings to scale and hide sensitive text before sharing.

Browse and research
Use the built-in browser to read and research without leaving Nautilus. Open pages in tabs and bookmark sites. Ask AI about a webpage, summarize or translate it, or turn it into notes.

Use Magic Lasso and AI
Circle a passage or other content with Magic Lasso, then ask AI to explain or summarize what you selected. Get help with your own writing too: rewrite, simplify, correct spelling and grammar, adjust the tone, or chat through an idea.

Capture ideas, then find them again
Record lectures, meetings and ideas. Listen back, or create a transcript so you can find important details later. Connect notes, images and recordings on whiteboards, collect quick thoughts on sticky notes, and organize plans in outlines. Bring research together in Study Projects. Plan a book or long paper with sections and a visual Corkboard. Keep sources beside your draft, save snapshots as you revise, then compile a finished document or ebook.

Work through calculations
Use Math Notebooks to keep calculations and explanations together. Explore formulas, create charts and preview the finished PDF.

Organize and share
Keep notes in folders and notebooks. Give notebooks covers that make them easy to spot. Scan paper, import Word and other files, and find what you need with search. Export to PDF, Word, HTML, EPUB and more. Sync with iCloud, Dropbox, Box, Google Drive or WebDAV.

Autosave, document recovery and automatic backups help protect your progress. Use passcodes for the app or private folders. Your existing Notes Writer PDF notes and outlines open in Nautilus.
